top_news.title: Show HN: AI search for every photo and every frame of video on macOS
top_news.dek: SCM is a local-first macOS tool that enables semantic search across your personal photo libraries and video files.
top_news.brief: The tool uses local vision models to index images and video frames, allowing users to search for memories using natural language. It supports OCR for text detection and Whisper for spoken dialogue, enabling precise navigation to specific moments within video files. All processing occurs on-device, ensuring data privacy without cloud uploads.
top_news.image_alt: SCM interface showing search results for video frames and photos on macOS

top_news.title: Counterexample Generation via Per-Theorem Symbolic Verifiers: When Imitation Hurts and Reinforcement Repairs
top_news.dek: Supervised fine-tuning often fails to help LLMs disprove false theorems, but reinforcement learning against symbolic verifiers can bridge this gap.
top_news.brief: Researchers identified a 'falsification gap' where LLMs struggle to disprove false conjectures despite being able to solve related true ones. Supervised fine-tuning often exacerbates this issue. The team introduced SymCE, a dataset of 4,707 false conjectures paired with executable Python verifiers, which serve as both a test suite and a reward signal for reinforcement learning.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing the workflow of LLM counterexample generation against a Python verifier.

top_news.title: AI is eroding office hours, study groups, and the trust between faculty and students, MIT report finds
top_news.dek: An MIT report highlights how widespread AI adoption is reducing student engagement in office hours, study groups, and collaborative research.
top_news.brief: A 2026 MIT report documents a decline in traditional academic interactions as students increasingly rely on AI. Faculty report difficulty in assessing student learning and note that policing AI usage is damaging the trust between instructors and students. The findings suggest that AI is fundamentally altering the social and collaborative fabric of the university experience.
top_news.image_alt: Conceptual illustration of a quiet university library with empty study desks.

primary.title: HakemBench: A Turkish Benchmark of Typed Decisions
primary.summary: HakemBench is a Turkish benchmark of typed decisions, in which the model under test reads a text, a question and a fixed set of options and returns a probability for every option. primary.title: Presentation: Building Reusable Evaluation Frameworks for Agentic AI Products
primary.summary: Susan Chang explains how Elastic transitioned from siloed, ad-hoc AI agent evaluations to a unified, production-grade framework. By Susan Chang

primary.title: AI is eroding office hours, study groups, and the trust between faculty and students, MIT report finds
primary.summary: An MIT expert committee warns that AI is eroding key parts of the college experience: office hours, study groups, and the school's flagship research program for undergraduates are all fading. Trust between faculty and students is breaking down, and some professors are even considering AI agents instead of students as research assistants. The university most closely tied to AI's origin story is now calling for a complete overhaul of higher education. The article AI is eroding office hours, study groups, and the trust between faculty and students, MIT report finds appeared first on The Decoder.

primary.title: Google researchers find a way to keep self-improving AI agents from memorizing their tests
primary.summary: Self-improving AI agents tend to memorize their test tasks, so their gains shrink or disappear on new ones. RRSI, a new method from Google researchers, reins in this effect and lifts scores on unseen benchmarks by up to 4.7 points while using about 30 percent fewer tokens than an unregularized version. The article Google researchers find a way to keep self-improving AI agents from memorizing their tests appeared first on The Decoder.
